description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Repeat.
